REFLECTION.decision: The coupling is IRREDUCIBLY DISTRIBUTED: a GRADUAL faithfulness-size curve with NO knee. Held-out node counts (of 103): 50%->34, 80%->56, 90%->72, 95%->80. No sparse or mid-size faithful subcircuit exists -- 90% faithfulness needs ~70% of the network, spanning all layers.
REFLECTION.anchors: full_is_clean=0.0, empty_is_corrupt=0.0 (R21: embed-clamp-forced normalization ANCHORS, not memorials); the F(K) scrub is A6-validated (A12 adds no new mechanic).

REFLECTION.cross_validation: STRONG independent cross-validation of the A6-A11 arc: the top-ranked nodes (by backward removal-loss from the FULL model, no knowledge of the hand-built circuit) ARE the identified mechanism -- embed #1 (address geometry C21/C22); MLP2/3/1/0/4/5 #2,3,5,6,7,8 (the A8/A10 MLP backbone + C17 delivery MLP3/4); L3H1 #4 (the reader); the generator L0 heads L0H7/H12/H10 #9,11,13 (A10/C31); the transporters L4H2/L5H11/L4H0 #10,12,15 (C18). The mechanism sits at the TOP of an independent importance ranking.
REFLECTION.reading: A STRUCTURED CORE (the identified circuit: embed -> L0H7/H12/H10 -> MLP0-2 generator -> L3H1 -> MLP3/4 + L4/L5 transporters) is the most-important set, embedded in a BROADLY DISTRIBUTED ~72-node faithful core. No sparse faithful circuit, but a clear importance hierarchy with the mechanism at the top -- reconciling A6 (non-faithful sparse circuit) with the identified structure (A7-A11).
REFLECTION.caveats: Static backward-rank = UPPER BOUND on the minimal faithful set at each F level (true lazy-greedy could shave a few nodes via interactions, but the gradual shape + ~70% requirement is robust to this). Greedy not guaranteed optimal. R21 anchors; embed-clamp domination does not affect the RANKING (F-differences).
